gphotos.note: Pinned to a 7.x version that predates APKPure's switch to 32-bit-only split-APK uploads. Recent Photos releases on APKPure ship config.armeabi_v7a.apk only — no arm64-v8a — so the merged APK refuses to install on modern 64-bit-only Android devices. Watch [abiInventory] log lines; if arm64-v8a appears, the pin is working.
